_comment: verified: false keeps a playthrough out of the planner (only ::advquest starts it) until a bot has finished it in game. Quests the adventurers really play (adventurers/QuestPlay.PlayerBots.js), step by step as a player does: walk to the NPC (at: [x, y, z]), Talk-to, and answer its dialogue. prefer: words of the options to pick, in order; any other option the first that is not a refusal. until: the quest stage the step leads to (the step is done when the quest reaches it), or "complete". Each step's NPC is looked for by name around `at`. needs: items the step hands over (it checks them before going). places: underground areas and the ladder in and out (bots walk only on one plane of the map; a basement is reached by its ladder). Checked in game with the agent MCP, start to finish.
